mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are looking at 61 degrees under partly cloudy skies out along the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are under a Full Moon tonight.

City officials are busy with the upcoming November 4th meeting, where they will review several developments including the Ardent Glen project and new site plans on Milky Way. Also, keep in mind that property tax bills will be arriving in the mail by December 15th.

There is a lot to do in the area! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for October 26th at Insight Wellness.

Turning to local safety, the Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday, October 15th, involving the arrest of a school bus driver for O W I. No students were injured during the event.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is the delicious Turtle. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
